kevin: just finished the deploy to prod (canary -> 10%). please run quick verification steps below and report any red flags. targeting ramp to 50% after thumbs-up in 20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia: grabbing smoke checklist now. I'll run the health endpoints and a few sample requests.

marta: I'll watch the latency/error graphs (https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/prod/latency) during the next 10m.

deploy-bot: Deployment completed by kevin at 2026-03-17T12:34:38Z — canary=10% — status=ok

sam: saw one 500 from canary at 12:36, digging. PR #3482 has a small fix for edge case parsing, can push hotfix if needed. pinging reviewers @tia @marta

tia: on it, reviewing PR. if it's low-risk we can merge and patch-canary without rollback.

kevin: rollback toggle ready: `infra rollback --id=deploy-2062345678` — SRE standby ok? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: standby confirmed. if we flip rollback we have automation to drain new traffic in ~30s.

olivia: smoke commands I'm running:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"sanity check"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
```
expectation: health => `ok`; generate => non-empty tokens, < 500ms p95 in canary

marta: graph snippet: p95 latency bumped from 180ms -> 260ms for canary at 12:35 but no error spike. will keep observing.

sam: PR #3482 merged and deployed to canary at 12:40. small change to request validation. no regressions in unit tests.

olivia: re-running generate test. result looks good. sample output starts with "All systems nominal" — sending screenshot.

kevin: thanks — if all green, we'll ramp to 50% in 10m. if any error >0.5% or p95 > 400ms we pause and rollback.

marta: creating a short watchlist: errors >0.5%, 4xx spikes, tokenization errors, p95 > 400ms. alerting channel set.

tia: prod-review acked. LGTM on the small change. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Traffic ramp scheduled: 10% -> 50% at 12:50 UTC unless cancelled.

kevin: final call — any blockers? if not, I'll start ramp at 12:50 UTC.

sam: no blockers from infra side. go for it.

olivia: no blockers from QA.

marta: watching — will shout if thresholds breach.

kevin: ramp started. thanks everyone. :rocket:
